messages:
Carla (AE): @Jordan quick follow-up from today's presales call — can you confirm the exact asks so we scope the POC? I heard: domain ownership proof, group->role mapping via SCIM, SAML session length, delegated admin, and audit export. Anything else?

Jordan (Client): Correct. Okta as IdP. Expect ~200k users, ~50k groups. Need mapping of Okta groups -> roles (admin/editor/viewer). Audit log export to our S3 bucket is preferred but not blocking.

Sam (SE): For the POC we can provide a Dedicated test pool (4x A100) and a sandbox tenant. SCIM delta sync for 200k users is doable but we'll want to tune rate limits. What's your acceptable delta window? 5 min? 15 min?

Jordan (Client): 15 min window ideal. Initial bulk import acceptable for cutover.

Sam (SE): Ok. For clarity, sample SCIM->role mapping we'll test:
```json
{
  "schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "groups_to_roles":[
    {"okta_group":"eng-team","role":"editor"},
    {"okta_group":"platform-admins","role":"admin"},
    {"okta_group":"support","role":"viewer"}
  ]
}
```

Priya (Security): A few security checks: we need SAML attribute statement details (NameID format, groups claim), confirm JIT provisioning allowance, and require SCIM over HTTPS with client certs / mTLS in POC. Also audit trail retention >= 1 year is a hard ask.

Tom (Legal): If audit export to customer S3 is required, we need to confirm data residency, encryption at rest, and update the DPA/contract to include export and retention SLAs. Delegated admin implies we must define role boundaries in contract too.

Jordan (Client): We can deliver sample group lists and confirm NameID format (transient vs persistent) — leaning persistent. We'll also share SOC2 attestation.

Carla (AE): Great — next steps: Jordan please DM Okta org URL + sample group CSV. Sam will open an ops ticket to request temporary SCIM rate bump for the POC. Legal (Tom) and Security (Priya) will draft required contract language checklist. Proposed POC timeline: baseline tests 2 weeks, scale/cleanup 1 week.

Sam (SE): I'll open ticket OPS-5678 and cc eng-sre for quota increase. Also will prepare a short runbook for bulk import -> scim delta -> role mapping tests.

Priya (Security): We'll need to validate cert pinning and provide config snippet for client cert setup during POC.

Tom (Legal): I'll draft DPA amendment language and flag any export-related risks. Aim to send a redline by EOD Friday.

Jordan (Client): Thanks everyone — sending Okta URL and group CSV now via DM. One more Q: can Redwood support initial bulk CSV import (one-time) and then SCIM delta after cutover?

Sam (SE): Yes — we support CSV -> SCIM bulk import for initial provisioning, then delta sync. We'll include that in the runbook.

Carla (AE): Perfect. I'll compile the POC checklist and contract asks and share in this thread tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Jordan (Client): Appreciated, talk soon.
